title: pyALDIC-3D: stereo / 3D Digital Image Correlation built on the pyALDIC platform
description: pyALDIC-3D is an independent, self-contained desktop application and headless CLI for stereo (two-camera) Digital Image Correlation. It reconstructs full-field 3D shape, displacement, and Green-Lagrange surface strain from synchronized stereo image sequences, using the Augmented-Lagrangian DIC engine of the pyALDIC 2D platform (al-dic) and following the MATLAB 3D-Stereo-ALDIC reference implementation as its mathematical model. Features include built-in QC-instrumented stereo calibration (chessboard, ChArUco, circle-grid, coded circular targets, plus 6 import formats), three pluggable correspondence strategies, crack-aware DIC, an interactive PyVista 3D view, NPZ/MAT/CSV/PLY/VTU export, an 8-language GUI, and a TOML-driven batch CLI.
